description: What an Arc wallet holds with a USD value per token: native USDC, EURC and APEX, plus up to 20 tokens you list. Balances read live; each token priced from its deepest Uniswap v4 USDC pool (a token with no pool says so). A failed read is refused before payment. $0.002 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

tokens.description: optional: up to 20 more token addresses, comma-separated

name: arc_wallet_value
